items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08
items.q: He's Hawkins. Hawkins brother. Well, their sister's children and I went to the movies together.

ctx.x: Well, that didn't interest me. You know, it didn't interest us.

We would rush out to get us stripes and we're in something to keep in the mood. But I know he gambled with my brother. And you knew it was jelly because of your brother. Sure, everybody knew it in the middle. He's Hawkins. Hawkins brother. Well, their sister's children and I went to the movies together. They were in their house a lot playing the piano. They had a piano also. Was his name up at all in the movie?
